_meta.description: The Counter sale page of design.md D6 (REQ-RPPO-006), under Sales: a phone-sized page that records a counter sale and takes its payment on the user's phone.

pages.title: Counter sale
pages._note: Records a sale and drives its payment on the user's phone, which no index, detail or form page type does: the lines become a draft simplified ARInvoice through POST /api/financial-documents/counter-sales, the capture issues it and a failed payment or Customer walked away cancels it. See src/views/CounterSalePage.vue.
